proposed_next_slice.name: Local55 waveform descriptor pipeline v1
proposed_next_slice.implementation: One small new CLI/module with freeze, extract, evaluate, export and verify operations; explicit paths, no network, no new dependencies. Parent must approve/freeze this scope before implementation/compute.
proposed_next_slice.freeze_before_values: Hash permitted manifest and all55 MP3s, source component roster, ordered native IDs, tool versions, code and exact protocol. Preserve original component train/validation/test membership; no relabeling or split search.
proposed_next_slice.extract: Decode only verified local MP3 snapshots using offline ffmpeg, mono22050Hz float32 PCM, at most31seconds perclip. NumPy float64 Hann2048 FFT with1024hop; retain complete frames only (shorter-than2048samples abstains). Exactly52 columns: population mean/std over frames of24 log-mel band energies and RMS/ZCR. No archived44 equivalence claim.
proposed_next_slice.deterministic_baseline: Fit center and population scale on47 original-training rows only (fail closed if any extraction fails until a separately reviewed missingness policy). Zero-variance columns inactive at scale<=1e-12; reject nonfinite values and standard offsets>12 with explicit abstention. Unit-normalize active standardized52D vectors; rank cosine distance with native-ID exact ties; evaluation candidates only47training rows, exclude query component, one nearest candidate per component.
proposed_next_slice.learned_comparator: Only train-fitted PCA2 for required map geometry; no PCA8 and no classifier. Symmetric covariance of standardized47training rows, np.linalg.eigh descending eigenvalues; largest-absolute loading positive (lowest feature index resolves ties). Report eigengaps/variance. Holdout positions transformed without refitting. Near-degenerate selected eigenspaces flagged; map remains numerical structure, not genre groundtruth.
proposed_next_slice.evaluation: Frozen topk1,3 diagnostics: heldout6 query rows against47training candidates under identical component exclusions/ties. Compare raw52D cosine ranking, PCA2 Euclidean projected ranking (projection diagnostic only), native-ID baseline. Report per-query positive-source-tag hits and recovered-known-tag counts divided by all observed query tags and by training-observed query tags separately. Zero denominator is null/unsupported, never removed silently. One test query has zero train-observed tags. Also report top3 neighbor overlap between raw and2D and raw-vs-projected rank disagreement. Validation2 separate, no tuning. No musical precision/global quality/parity claim.
proposed_next_slice.genre_representation: Use direct source names only. Train-positive centroids require at least3 distinct training components; unsupported genres remain in source list without a learned center. Display sample support. No invented genre boundaries or artist-genre facts.
proposed_next_slice.export: Fresh self-contained site containing only permitted55 IDs/audio/credits, actual feature/model receipts, 2D track geometry, bounded inferred neighbor links and sourcegenre browsing. All55 remain reachable including abstentions/unplaced records; playback explicit, one persistent player, silent reload. No imported133 website/fullcatalog references.
proposed_next_slice.resources: Preserve120seconds CPU/wall and1GBAS per stage,100MB total numeric/intermediate outputs (audio unchanged55clips<=64MB). Decode serially with20seconds perclip timeout,31seconds22050Hz mono float32 cap=2,734,200 PCM bytes/clip; cap retained output before allocation; stop without cap escalation. Static JSON shards<=200KB. No dependency/network/acquisition.
proposed_next_slice.replay: Physical deterministic fixtures (silence,sine tones,amplitude scaling,zero crossings) test feature meaning; no test fixtures become FMA audio. Save all learned arrays+column/split/tool/code hashes; exact loaded-vs-original transforms/rankings and independent extraction/linear-algebra replay with declared1e-10 absolute/1e-8 relative feature tolerance; exact nativeID ranking or explicit tie-stability failure. Rebuild artifact hashes identical for semantic outputs excluding elapsed/resource logs.
proposed_next_slice.decision: Completion means working source→waveform features→train-fitted layout→deterministic retrieval→heldout diagnostics→playable static export, not superiority. Use raw52D for neighbor serving even when PCA2 tag scores differ. No learned classifier is justified by only47training clips/93sparse tags.

completion_criteria: Single documented local command sequence runs freeze/extract/evaluate/export/verify from retained55 without hidden historicalsite dependency or network.
Every exported identity/credit/audiohash joins permitted manifest exactly; component provenance retained separately without raw unrestricted metadata in website.
All55 extraction rows or explicit reasoned failures accounted for; extraction proves audio bytes were consumed and no source labels entered feature computation.
Normalization/PCA fit uses train only; test/validation rows never update parameters; tests detect leakage and samecomponent retrieval.
Raw52D, projected2D and native-ID ranking diagnostics use identical pools/exclusions/ties/denominators; preserve perquery and unsupported outcomes regardless of favorability.
Independent replay passes under frozen guards; map geometry derives from actual feature fit, not editorial coordinates.
Actual browser verifies all55 playable IDs, genre/artist/source links, no initial autoplay, keyboard/list alternative, mobile fit and no external requests.
Delivered README explains source-provided vs deterministic vs learned vs editorial stages with exact run commands and honest limits.

v2_conventions.precedence: These explicit conventions supersede any less precise wording in inherited proposed_next_slice.
v2_conventions.zero_norm: L2 norm<=1e-12 abstains. Standardized active coordinate absolute>12 abstains. Nonfinite extraction fails whole stage, no smaller training fit. All47training rows fit center/population scale/PCA, inactive columns scale<=1e-12.
v2_conventions.pool: Eligible original47training tracks finite, in support and norm>1e-12. Raw/PCA2/native-ID baselines start with identical eligible tracks, exclude querycomponent. Each method sorts by its distance then nativeID and greedily keeps one track per component; IDbaseline sorts nativeID only. All55 queries retained; all6 test outcomes retained even unsupported. Serving uses same eligibletraining pool and <=6 rawcosine neighbors; PCA2 never supplies servingneighbors.
v2_conventions.PCA: Float64 symmetric covariance, eigh descending eigenvalues. Let tolerance=1e-10*max(1,largest eigenvalue). Require >=2 eigenvalues>tolerance and both lambda1-lambda2 and lambda2-lambda3>tolerance (absentlambda3=0). Otherwise allpositions null/projection_degenerate, rawranking still usable. Sign largestabsolute loading positive; lowestfeatureindex tie. No alternatebasis/refit/thresholdsearch. Covariance exactly Z_train.T@Z_train/47 (population divisor).
v2_conventions.decode: No -t truncation. Verified local snapshot, ffmpeg -xerror, file input and pipe output only; mono22050Hz littleendianfloat32. Stream stdout cap2734200bytes (31seconds), readcap+1 then kill/reject overlong. Require successfulexit, complete4bytesamples, >=2048samples, finitePCM;20seconds perclip. Boundstderr concurrently; never unbounded communicate. Any failure aborts finalartifact promotion. Full source completion required; no silent truncation.
v2_conventions.labels: Globaltraining support from all47source-label rows regardless of candidateeligibility. Separately report eligibletraining labelset and query-specific postcomponent-exclusion labelset. Each query allobservedtag denominator and known-tag denominator(querytags intersect global47trainlabelset) remain fixed; never substitute smallerpool support. Zero denominator=null/unsupported; unsupportedvector queries retain zero-retrieved outcomes with explicitreason. One testquery with no globaltrainknownlabels remains counted.
v2_conventions.rank_disagreement: For shared eligiblecandidate pool, compare top3 rawcosine vs projectedEuclidean, both componentdiverse. overlap=intersection nativeIDs / min(3,eligiblecomponentcount), null if zero or projection unavailable. Normalized symmetric top3 rank footrule: union oftop3IDs, missingrank4; sumabsolute rankdifferences/12 (maximum12 for disjoint fulltop3lists). Store rawlists and unnormalized sum as well.
v2_conventions.label_permutation: Features/PCA/trackcoordinates/trackrankings invariant under source-tag permutation; namedgenrecentroids and annotationmetrics intentionally depend on tags.
v2_conventions.resources: 120seconds CPU/wall and1GBAS perstage;100MB allnumeric/intermediateoutput; serial55decode; unchanged64MBaudio/2MBMP3 cap; <=200KBviewJSONshards. No capincrease.
v2_conventions.replay: Same source versions and orderedrows: saved-loadedtransform exactly matches original; independent numerical tolerance abs1e-10 rel1e-8; rankings exact or explicit tie-stabilityfailure. Physicalfixtures silence/sines/amplitude/ZCR; no syntheticfixture in realcandidate.

metric_conventions.hit_at_k: Query-level boolean: at least one of firstk neighbor tracks has nonempty intersection with any observed query source tags. Empty neighbors=>false. Store number of matching neighbors separately, not precision.
metric_conventions.recall_all_at_k: Union source tags across firstk neighbors intersect queryobservedtags; divide by number queryobservedtags. Missing denominator=>null.
metric_conventions.recall_known_at_k: Recovered union intersect queryobservedtags intersect global47trainingtags; divide by queryobservedtags intersect global47trainingtags. Empty denominator=>null, preserve query row.
metric_conventions.aggregates: For test6 and validation2 separately, counts for total/supported/known-supported/unsupported, query-level hit sum/totalqueries, recall means only over defined denominators with explicit count; perquery outcomes primary. Unsupported vectors yield emptyneighbors and zero where denominator nonzero.
metric_conventions.projection_support: Raw zero_norm query abstains from all three evaluation arms for shared comparability; out_of_support likewise. Projectiondegenerate makes projected arm unavailable(nullmetrics) for everyquery; raw/ID continue. Eligibletraining zero-norm/OOD tracks removed from all three pools identically.
metric_conventions.receipt_binding: Unified protocol.json contains these exact metric semantics, hashed by declaration and finalinventory. Receipt hashes features/model/evaluation and declaration. Layout binds receipt and protocol hashes; finalinventory hashes allfiles without selfhash.

genre_centroid_rule: All47training rows eligible for namedcentroids after rawsupport filter. Count sourcepositive trainingtracks/components beforefilter and eligibletracks/components separately. Require>=3 eligible distinctcomponents. Arithmetic mean of eligible sourcepositive track PCA2 positions; no weighting, no heldouttracks. Missingprojection=>null. Labels only aggregate namedcentroids and evaluate.
